name: v0.51.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Benchmark scope selection cost by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2145
* feat(workspace): extract bounded OpenAPI schemas by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2227
* feat(generation): improve onboarding evidence and grounding by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2228
* feat(workspace): compare OpenAPI schemas directionally by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2229
* feat(workspace): resolve local Maven package dependencies by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2231
* fix(update): reconcile config-driven index changes by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2235
* fix(index): persist analyzed symbol complexity by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2236
* feat(indexing): make Git history sampling reliable by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2244
* feat(ingestion): add COBOL language support by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/1770
* feat(indexing): make fast and full scope truthful by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2246
* fix(ci): restore deterministic Python checks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2250
* fix(ui): raise floating layers above modals so selects open in front by @jgt87 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2173
* fix(ingestion): warn when a language query fails to compile (#2166) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2177
* fix(server): register workspace members and fan-out search on shared database (#2138) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2195
* fix(cli): warn Windows users before upgrading by @roian6 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2204
* fix(augment): gate the rescue's FTS fallback on query-token coverage (#2092) by @punk-dev-robot in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2214
* fix(ui): clamp generation progress percentages by @akkupratap323 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2224
* fix(cli): honor editor_files opt-outs during init and update by @z2Ace0107 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2226
* Fix API client handling of 204 No Content responses by @Selene29 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2237
* Match Kimi K2 and K3 reasoning contracts by @Selene29 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2238
* Fix DeepSeek thinking controls and effort mapping by @Selene29 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2239
* fix(reindex): bound failed batch recovery by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2251
* fix(ci): stabilize MCP reference inventory cap by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2256
* fix(ui): contain long AI prompts inside modal by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2249
* test: isolate cross-tool omission inventory by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2258
* fix(indexing): make stale-page recovery converge by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2254
* refactor(analysis): separate change-analysis semantics from git and transport by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2263
* refactor(risk): score the range endpoint through the shared facade by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2268
* release: v0.51.0 — an index that says what it actually covers by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2269

## New Contributors
* @roian6 made their first contribution in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2204
* @punk-dev-robot made their first contribution in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2214
* @akkupratap323 made their first contribution in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2224
* @z2Ace0107 made their first contribution in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2226

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/compare/v0.50.0...v0.51.0
